issues.text: `--no-cache` disables all of apk's local cache paths (apk help: "prevents using any local cache paths"), not only the package list; "only" narrows it more than the tool does.
issues.quote: its `--no-cache` option only stops `apk` keeping its own download list in the image
issues.fix: Replace with: "its `--no-cache` option stops `apk` keeping its own downloaded files (such as its package list) in the image". Keep the rest of the sentence. Claim 8 text: "avoids keeping apk's cached downloads (package index) in the image".

issues.text: "each RUN step" overgeneralises: in the learner's own `docker history` output the base-image RUN rows read `RUN |3 BUILD_DATE=... /bin/sh -c ...` and `RUN |6 ... /bin/sh -c ...`, with build settings before `/bin/sh -c`. Claim 8 is also filed under section 5 while this sentence is in section 7.
issues.quote: Docker shows each `RUN` step as `/bin/sh -c` followed by the command
issues.fix: Replace "each `RUN` step" with "a `RUN` step" and append "(rows from the base image may show some build settings before it)". Split the /bin/sh -c part of claim 8 into its own claim with section 7.

issues.text: `apk` / `apk add` is never explained. I can guess from context that it installs the four tools, but I do not know what apk is, and `--no-cache` in the same line looks to me like it switches off the very cache this lesson is about. The lesson never says it has nothing to do with Docker's cache.
issues.quote: `RUN apk add --no-cache ...` then adds one layer on top, holding the four tools the lessons use.
issues.fix: Add one sentence after this one: "`apk` is the package installer of the base image's Linux; its `--no-cache` option is about apk's own downloads and does not affect Docker's layer cache."
